title: ReadyESM v0.1.18 — model skill
scope: D4 control: six months with the v0.1.17 settings and source a2f2ac4, not the published tag. v0.1.18: source 48c232c. Three paired members per month, 31 days, 1993.

neutral_release_decision.rule: Accept NEUTRAL within each frozen noise bound; reject only clear WORSE or a failed guard.

rules.observed_ice_bias: reported separately; small consistent worsening is not an automatic veto
rules.ocean_area_weighted_surface_temperature_: each paired day-31 absolute SST change <= max(control sample SD, 0.25 K)
rules.sea_ice_area: each paired day-31 absolute area change <= max(control sample SD, 5% of that control's area)

breakage.scope: three fresh paired members per season, or six after escalation; gross SST and ice-area breakage only

physical_note: Frozen v3 and v4 verdicts are shown as scored. The neutral release decision is separate.
